marketMood: Risk-off: US-Iran military escalation in the Strait of Hormuz sends Brent crude above $91, driving US bond yields to 18-month highs and triggering a broad equity sell-off ahead of key US labour data.

topStories.headline: US and Iran Trade Strikes in Strait of Hormuz, Disrupting Month of Calm
topStories.summary: US forces struck Iranian rocket launchers in the Strait of Hormuz over the weekend; Iran responded with attacks on UAE and Jordan, shattering a month of relative calm and reigniting fears over oil supply disruption.
topStories.marketImpact: Brent crude ↑ above $91, up ~4% intraday; shipping stocks ↓ amid maritime traffic decline; defence names ↑ on heightened geopolitical risk

topStories.headline: US 10-Year Treasury Yield Hits 4.80%, Highest Since January 2025
topStories.summary: The US 10-year yield rose for a fifth consecutive session to 4.80% as surging oil prices stoke inflation expectations and markets price in a ~68% chance of a Fed rate hike this month, with the 30-year yield reaching 5.28%.
topStories.marketImpact: Equities broadly ↓; rate-sensitive growth/tech stocks ↓↓; bond prices ↓; VIX ↑ ~9%

topStories.headline: ADP August Jobs Report: 44K vs 68K Forecast, Labour Market Cooling
topStories.summary: Private payrolls grew by just 44,000 in August, sharply below the 68,000 consensus estimate and down from the prior month's revised 95,000, signalling a notable cooling in the US labour market.
topStories.marketImpact: Mixed: softens near-term Fed hawkishness → mild bond relief ↑; but raises recession watch signals; Friday's NFP now closely watched

topStories.headline: Broadcom Set to Report Q3 Earnings After Close; AI Revenue Seen at $16B
topStories.summary: Broadcom (AVGO) reports fiscal Q3 earnings after the bell, with Wall Street expecting $29.43B in revenue — up 84% year-on-year — driven almost entirely by AI chip and custom silicon demand.
topStories.marketImpact: AVGO ↑ or ↓ sharply post-close depending on guidance; AI semiconductor peers (NVDA, MRVL) will take directional cues

topStories.headline: Snowflake Q2 Earnings After Close; Stock Up 90% in Six Months
topStories.summary: Snowflake (SNOW) reports Q2 FY2027 earnings after market close today, with consensus revenue at $1.48B (up ~30% year-on-year); investors will focus on product revenue growth and consumption trends amid elevated AI data spending.
topStories.marketImpact: SNOW stock ↑ or ↓ — historically moves ~13% on earnings; data cloud peers (DBRX, MDB, PLTR) watch closely

topStories.headline: BOJ Set to Hike Rates at September 17–18 Meeting as Yen Stays Weak
topStories.summary: The Bank of Japan is widely expected to raise rates at its upcoming meeting, with US Treasury Secretary Bessent signalling support for BOJ action; oil-driven inflation pushing core CPI above the 2% target provides the main justification.
topStories.marketImpact: JPY ↑ vs USD (yen strengthens on rate expectations); JGB yields ↑ — Japan 10Y touched 3% for first time since 1996; rate-sensitive financials ↑, exporters ↓

topStories.headline: Nikkei Falls 0.6% as Tech Stocks Lead Losses on Rate Hike and AI Fears
topStories.summary: Japan's Nikkei 225 slipped below 66,000, dragged down by sharp declines in semiconductor and AI-infrastructure stocks including Tokyo Electron (-4.6%), Advantest (-2.9%), and Fujikura (-3%) as rate hike fears combine with a global tech rout.

topStories.headline: Hang Seng Posts Worst Week in Over a Year; Beijing Deploys 60B Yuan to Prop Up AI Stocks
topStories.summary: The Hang Seng Index closed its worst week in more than a year as a renewed technology sell-off swept Hong Kong markets; Beijing's national team deployed roughly 60 billion yuan (~$9B) to buy AI-related stocks in an effort to stem the decline.
topStories.marketImpact: 0700.HK ↓, 9988.HK ↓; state-supported names may see partial recovery; sentiment remains cautious on profitability gap despite AI tech milestones

companiesToWatch.name: Snowflake

companiesToWatch.name: ExxonMobil

companiesToWatch.name: Tokyo Electron
companiesToWatch.reason: Fell 4.6% in Tokyo session as BOJ rate hike expectations and a global tech selloff hit Japan's AI equipment supply chain especially hard.

companiesToWatch.reason: Reports Q3 earnings alongside Broadcom today after close; enterprise IT spending trends and AI server demand will be key focal points.

quickHits: VIX surged ~9% on Tuesday, reflecting the sharpest single-day spike in investor anxiety since May 2026 (Bloomberg)
Japan's 10-year bond yield touched 3% for the first time since 1996, amplifying global fixed income volatility (Nikkei Asia)
South Korea's KOSPI remains ~40% below its June 2026 record high as China AI competition continues to weigh on semiconductor names (The Diplomat)
Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) and NetApp (NTAP) also report earnings after the close today alongside Broadcom and Snowflake (CNBC)
